firestore.reasoning: The Firestore data structure is designed to support the SIM Blog application's core features: Investment Simulation, Risk Assessment, Portfolio Tracking, Market News Integration, and an AI Analyst Tool.  The design prioritizes Authorization Independence and QAPs (Rules are not Filters). This is achieved through path-based ownership and structural segregation. User-owned data (Portfolios, Transactions, RiskAssessments) is nested under the `/users/{userId}` collection.  This structure eliminates the need for `get()` calls in security rules, enabling atomic operations (transactions/batches).  For QAPs, data segregation is used.  All documents within a collection share the same security posture.  This ensures efficient and secure list operations, as filtering occurs on the client-side after authorization is confirmed.
